title: CanPUFF Edibles profile: supply overlay v1
description: Overlay. Validate a supply against this schema in addition to https://canpuff.org/schemas/v1/supply.json. It constrains only the fields the Edibles profile adds; a supply that does not use them passes unchanged. Cross-field rules (grams absent with unit each, quantity only with unit each) are in the profile and the reference validator.

unit.description: Measurement basis of the package. Absent or g: grams/gramsStart are the quantity. each: quantity/quantityStart count pieces and grams/gramsStart MUST be absent.

quantity.description: pieces, max 2 decimal places (partial pieces are allowed). Used only when unit is each.

quantityStart.description: pieces, max 2 decimal places (partial pieces are allowed). Used only when unit is each.

mgPerUnit.description: mg per piece for count-based (unit each) products; at most four decimal places. Infused products are already activated, so there is no as-sold/total split.
